name: Eval pipeline — turn an accepted finding into an eval case, then find it on the Eval Dashboard and the agent's Evals tab
description: Uses the seeded decided findings of PR #482 (server/src/db/seed.ts: an OLDER General Reviewer review with 11 findings, 6 accepted, 4 dismissed, 1 undecided; the 2-finding agent-less review stays the newest, so flows 02/04 are unaffected). Opens that older run, expands its first card (always a CRITICAL, and both seeded CRITICAL findings are accepted), clicks 'Turn into eval case' once and sees the must_find tag replace the button. Then opens the Eval Dashboard from the sidebar, opens the General Reviewer card (a case but no runs yet: the 'No eval runs yet' empty state) and finally Agents -> General Reviewer -> Evals tab, which lists the new case ('0 / 1 passing'). NEVER presses Run eval or Run all agents: those make paid LLM calls (scripts/e2e.sh does not isolate secrets, e2e/INSIGHTS.md). The sidebar highlight is not asserted here (the item has no ARIA state); it is covered by client RTL (nav.test.ts).
